_comment: Tier-2 for dune::reaction_diffusion#0, #1 and #2 — three compiled forms (implicit scalar, explicit mass-matrix scalar, coupled two-species) with dt and the reaction rate as dune.ufl.Constants so the stability sweep is free; wall time 936 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2) under heavy contention, most of it C++ builds. Measured on an 8x8 P1 grid with lambda=50: the reaction R(u)=lambda*u*(1-u) written directly in the TRIAL function is accepted and the scheme's internal Newton linearises it (2 iterations, converged). Explicit stepping at dt=0.0200, half the 2/lambda=0.0400 limit, stayed finite over ten steps; at dt=0.8000, twenty times the limit, it produced non-finite values, while the IMPLICIT scheme at that same dt stayed finite with max 1.2010. A scalar space rejects a two-component field with AttributeError; a dimRange=2 space with Schnakenberg-style cross-coupling in the form converged and the two species came out at different means (0.577593 vs 0.422496), so the coupling is real.
